mapper.select:
/* 판매정책조회 : MspMapper.findMspSaleOrgnMst */ SELECT PL.SALE_PLCY_CD --판매정책코드 FROM MSP_SALE_PLCY_MST PL, MSP_SALE_ORGN_MST ORG, MSP_SALE_PRDT_MST PRDT, ORG_INST_NOM_MST INST WHERE PL.CNFM_YN='Y' -- 결제 YN (필수) AND PL.SALE_PLCY_CD = ORG.SALE_PLCY_CD AND PL.SALE_PLCY_CD = PRDT.SALE_PLCY_CD AND ORG.SALE_PLCY_cD = PRDT.SALE_PLCY_CD AND PL.SALE_PLCY_CD = INST.SALE_PLCY_CD AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'yyyymmddhh24miss') BETWEEN PL.SALE_STRT_DTTM AND PL.SALE_END_DTTM --판매기간 (필수) AND PL.PLCY_TYPE_CD = #{plcyTypeCd} -- 온라인:O , 오프라인:M , 직영온라인 : D
AND PL.PLCY_SCTN_CD = #{reqBuyTypeCd.rateType} -- 01:단말,02:유심
AND ORG.ORGN_ID = #{agentCd} -- 대리점코드 AND INST.INST_NOM = #{modelMonthly} AND ( CASE WHEN #{operTypeCd} = 'HDN3' THEN PL.HDN_YN WHEN #{operTypeCd} = 'HCN3' THEN PL.HCN_YN WHEN #{operTypeCd} = 'MNP3' THEN PL.MNP_YN WHEN #{operTypeCd} = 'NAC3' THEN PL.NEW_YN END ) = 'Y'
AND PL.SPRT_TP = #{sprtTp} -- KD:단말할인,PM:요금할인
AND PL.PRDT_SCTN_CD = #{prdtSctnCd} -- LTE,3G
AND PRDT.PRDT_ID = #{prdtId} -- 단말기ID (자급제인 경우는 SKIP 처리 - 스마트는 해당안될테지만)
GROUP BY PL.SALE_PLCY_CD

/* 판매정책조회 : MspMapper.findMspSaleOrgnMst */ SELECT PL.SALE_PLCY_CD , --판매정책코드 PL.SALE_PLCY_NM, --판매정책명 PL.SALE_STRT_DTTM, --판매시작일시 PL.SALE_END_DTTM, --판매종료일시 PL.PLCY_TYPE_CD, --정책유형코드 M:오프라인, O:온라인 PL.ORGN_TYPE, --조직유형 PL.PLCY_SCTN_CD, --정책구분코드 01:단말, 02:USIM PL.PRDT_SCTN_CD, --제품구분코 02:3G, 03:LTE PL.APPL_SCTN_CD, --적용구분코드 O:개통일, R:접수일 PL.INST_RATE, --할부이자율 PL.NEW_YN, --신규여부 PL.MNP_YN, --번호이동여부 PL.HCN_YN, --기변여부 PL.HDN_YN, --우수기변여부 PL.SPRT_TP, --할인유형 (SELECT DTL_CD_NM FROM NMCP_CD_DTL@DL_MCP WHERE CD_GROUP_ID='F002' AND USE_YN='Y' AND PL.SPRT_TP=DTL_CD) AS SPRT_NM, --할인유형명 ORG.ORGN_ID, --조직 PRDT.PRDT_ID -- 단말아이디 FROM MSP_SALE_PLCY_MST PL, MSP_SALE_ORGN_MST ORG, MSP_SALE_PRDT_MST PRDT WHERE PL.CNFM_YN='Y' -- 결제 YN (필수) AND PL.SALE_PLCY_CD = ORG.SALE_PLCY_CD AND PL.SALE_PLCY_CD = PRDT.SALE_PLCY_CD AND ORG.SALE_PLCY_cD = PRDT.SALE_PLCY_CD AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'yyyymmddhh24miss') BETWEEN PL.SALE_STRT_DTTM AND PL.SALE_END_DTTM --판매기간 (필수) AND PL.PLCY_TYPE_CD = #{plcyTypeCd} -- 온라인:O , 오프라인:M , 직영온라인 : D AND PL.PLCY_SCTN_CD = #{reqBuyTypeCd.rateType} -- 01:단말,02:유심 AND ORG.ORGN_ID = #{agentCd} -- 대리점코드 AND PL.SPRT_TP = #{sprtTp} -- KD:단말할인,PM:요금할인
AND PL.PRDT_SCTN_CD = #{prdtSctnCd} -- LTE,3G
AND PRDT.PRDT_ID = #{prdtId} -- 단말기ID (자급제인 경우는 SKIP 처리)
AND PL.INST_RATE IS NULL
AND PL.INST_RATE IS NOT NULL

/** 안심보험 목록 조회 **/ SELECT DISTINCT T1.INSR_PROD_CD , T1.CMPN_LMT_AMT , T1.INSR_ENGG_CNT , DTL_CD_NM AS INSR_PROD_NM FROM MSP_INTM_INSR_MST T1 , ( SELECT DTL_CD , DTL_CD_NM FROM NMCP_CD_DTL@DL_MCP WHERE CD_GROUP_ID = 'IntmInsrRelNm' ) T2 WHERE 1=1 AND T1.INSR_PROD_CD = T2.DTL_CD(+) AND T1.USG_YN = 'Y'
AND T1.INSR_TYPE_CD = '02'
AND ( T1.INSR_PROD_CD IN (SELECT INSR_PROD_CD FROM MSP_INTM_INSR_REL WHERE RPRS_PRDT_ID = #{rprsPrdtId} AND APPL_YN = 'Y') OR T1.INSR_TYPE_CD = '02' )
AND T1.INSR_PROD_CD IN (SELECT INSR_PROD_CD FROM MSP_INTM_INSR_REL WHERE RPRS_PRDT_ID = #{rprsPrdtId} AND APPL_YN = 'Y')
AND T1.INSR_PROD_CD IN
#{insr.prodId}
ORDER BY T1.CMPN_LMT_AMT DESC

/* 요금제 목록 조회 MspMapper.listRateByOrgnInfos */ SELECT DISTINCT RATE_MST.RATE_CD, RATE_MST.RATE_NM, RATE_MST.RATE_GRP_CD, RATE_MST.PAY_CL_CD, RATE_MST.RATE_TYPE, RATE_MST.DATA_TYPE,
TRUNC(NVL(RATE_MST.BASE_AMT,0) * 1.1) AS BASE_AMT, RATE_MST.FREE_CALL_CL_CD, RATE_MST.FREE_CALL_CNT, RATE_MST.NW_IN_CALL_CNT, RATE_MST.NW_OUT_CALL_CNT, RATE_MST.FREE_SMS_CNT, RATE_MST.FREE_DATA_CNT, RATE_MST.RMK, RATE_MST.ONLINE_TYPE_CD, RATE_MST.AL_FLAG,
RATE_MST.SERVICE_TYPE, RATE_MST.JEHU_PROD_TYPE, --요금제제휴처 (SELECT DTL_CD_NM FROM NMCP_CD_DTL@DL_MCP WHERE CD_GROUP_ID='JehuProdType' AND DTL_CD=RATE_MST.JEHU_PROD_TYPE AND ROWNUM=1) AS JEHU_PROD_NM, -- 요금제 제휴처명 PLCY.SPRT_TP, PLCY.PLCY_SCTN_CD, --정책구분코드 01:단말, 02:USIM PLCY.PRDT_SCTN_CD, --제품구분코드 >> LTE5G, 5G, 3G, LTE PLCY.PLCY_TYPE_CD --CMN0050 정책유형코드 : W 도매 FROM MSP_SALE_ORGN_MST ORGN, MSP_SALE_PLCY_MST PLCY, MSP_SALE_RATE_MST RATE, MSP_RATE_MST RATE_MST WHERE 1=1 AND ORGN.SALE_PLCY_CD = PLCY.SALE_PLCY_CD AND PLCY.SALE_PLCY_CD = RATE.SALE_PLCY_CD AND RATE_MST.RATE_CD = RATE.RATE_CD AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'yyyymmddhh24miss') BETWEEN PLCY.SALE_STRT_DTTM AND PLCY.SALE_END_DTTM /* 판매기간 */
AND PLCY.CNFM_YN = 'Y' AND PLCY.PLCY_TYPE_CD = #{plcyTypeCd} AND RATE_MST.PAY_CL_CD = #{payClCd} AND ORGN.ORGN_ID = #{agentCd} /* 대리점코드 :: 조직코드 */ AND RATE_MST.SERVICE_TYPE = #{serviceType} AND PLCY.PLCY_SCTN_CD = #{reqBuyTypeCd.rateType} AND RATE_TYPE != '02'
AND PLCY.SPRT_TP = #{sprtTp} /* 할인유형 : KD, PM */
AND PLCY.PRDT_SCTN_CD = #{prdtSctnCd} /* 02 : LTE, 03 : 3G */
AND ORGN.SALE_PLCY_CD = #{salePlcyCd} /* 판매정책코드 */
AND RATE_MST.RATE_CD IN
#{rate.prodId}
ORDER BY RATE_MST.RATE_NM

SELECT RATE.RATE_CD , RATE.RATE_NM , RATE.PAY_CL_CD , RATE.DATA_TYPE , TRUNC(NVL(BASE_AMT,0) * 1.1) AS BASE_AMT , TRUNC(NVL(DC_AMT,0) * 1.1) AS DC_AMT
, (BASE_AMT*0.1) VAT , NVL(SPEC.AGRM_TRM, 0) AGRM_TRM
, RATE.SERVICE_TYPE , RATE.JEHU_PROD_TYPE --요금제제휴처 , (SELECT DTL_CD_NM FROM NMCP_CD_DTL@DL_MCP WHERE CD_GROUP_ID='JehuProdType' AND DTL_CD=RATE.JEHU_PROD_TYPE AND ROWNUM=1) AS JEHU_PROD_NM -- 요금제 제휴처명 FROM MSP_RATE_MST RATE , MSP_RATE_SPEC SPEC
WHERE 1=1
AND RATE.RATE_CD = SPEC.RATE_CD(+) AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'yyyymmddhh24miss') BETWEEN RATE.APPL_STRT_DT AND RATE.APPL_END_DT /* 판매기간 */ AND RATE.DATA_TYPE = #{prdtSctnCd} -- 'LTE' 5G적용 AND SPEC.AGRM_TRM(+) = '0' -- 무약정 AND RATE_TYPE = '02' -- USIM 요금제
AND RATE.RATE_CD IN
#{rate.prodId}

SELECT DISTINCT B.USE_PRD FROM NMCP_RATE_ADSVC_GDNC_PROD_REL@DL_MCP A INNER JOIN NMCP_RATE_ADSVC_GDNC_BAS@DL_MCP B ON B.RATE_ADSVC_GDNC_SEQ = A.RATE_ADSVC_GDNC_SEQ WHERE A.RATE_ADSVC_CD = #{rateCd} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.PSTNG_START_DATE < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND A.PSTNG_END_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.PSTNG_START_DATE < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND B.PSTNG_END_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND B.USE_PRD IS NOT NULL AND B.USE_PRD != '0'
SELECT DECODE(ETC3,'Y',ETC4,ETC1) AS JOIN_PRICE , DECODE(ETC3,'Y',ETC5,ETC2) AS SIM_PRICE FROM CMN_GRP_CD_MST WHERE GRP_ID = 'RCP0053' AND CD_VAL = #{priceGubun} AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT HNDST_AMT, --단말금액(VAT포함) INST_CMSN, --할부수수료(VAT포함) TRUNC(NVL(BASE_AMT,0) * 1.1) AS BASE_AMT, --기본료(VAT포함) TRUNC(NVL(DC_AMT,0) * 1.1) AS DC_AMT, --기본할인금액(VAT포함) TRUNC(NVL(ADD_DC_AMT,0) * 1.1) AS ADD_DC_AMT --추가할인금액(VAT포함)
FROM MSP_SALE_SUBSD_MST WHERE 1=1 AND OLD_YN = #{oldYn} --중고여부 AND ORGN_ID = #{agentCd} --조직코드 AND RATE_CD = #{rateCd} --요금제코드
AND PRDT_ID = #{modelId} --상품ID
AND ROWNUM = 1
SELECT (SELECT PRDT_CODE FROM CMN_INTM_MDL WHERE PRDT_ID = T1.RPRS_PRDT_ID) AS MODEL_NAME FROM CMN_INTM_MDL T1 WHERE 1=1 AND PRDT_ID = #{prodId} AND ROWNUM =1
SELECT RATE_CD ,DATA_TYPE FROM MSP_RATE_MST WHERE RATE_CD = #{socCd}
